name: no-stop-it
description: No. Stop it. Rules that keep agent-written code and writing from reading like AI output.

plugins.name: no-stop-it
plugins.description: Stop lists for agent-written code (narrating comments, boilerplate docstrings, emoji, blanket try/except, silent fallbacks) and for what the agent writes to people (paragraph PR descriptions, caveat sections, unverified claims, publishing on the user's behalf).
